experimentalEncoder.embeddingSource: learned additive feature vectors trained from positive and hard-negative phrase pairs, blended with the heuristic experimental embedding as a fixed prior
experimentalEncoder.quantization: sign bit quantization to binary code

caution: experimentalPatchCount still comes from the current patch packer. This hybrid prototype blends a learned embedding source with the existing heuristic experimental embedding before normalize -> sign, and it remains an experimental core candidate until the frozen holdouts pass.

entries.text: TypeScript Worker routing code: export default { async fetch(request, env) { const url = new URL(request.url); if (url.pathname === "/api/health") return Response.json({ ok: true, records: await env.CATALOG.count() }); if (url.pathname === "/api/search") return env.SEARCH.fetch(request); return new Response("not found", { status: 404 }); } }; This snippet tests request routing, JSON health output, service binding handoff, and explicit fallback behavior.

Cloudflare Worker dispatch code: async function handleRequest(request, env) { const path = new URL(request.url).pathname; switch (path) { case "/api/health": return Response.json({ ok: true, records: await env.CATALOG.count() }); case "/api/search": return env.SEARCH.fetch(request); default: return new Response("not found", { status: 404 }); } } This snippet describes the same routing intent with switch dispatch, service binding handoff, and 404 fallback behavior.

Proof gate validation code: function evaluateGate(report) { const semanticOk = report.evidenceAssessment.semanticSignal.allMarginsPositive === true; const collapseOk = report.evidenceAssessment.collapseChecks.signatureCollapse === false; const foldOk = report.summary.avgExperimentalPatchesPerEntry <= 3; return { passed: semanticOk && collapseOk && foldOk, semanticOk, collapseOk, foldOk }; } This code checks semantic margin, collapse safety, and fold shape before allowing a lock.

Acceptance gate test code: test("proof gate rejects collapsed reports", () => { const report = makeReport({ allMarginsPositive: true, signatureCollapse: true, avgPatchesPerEntry: 3 }); const gate = evaluateGate(report); assert.equal(gate.passed, false); assert.equal(gate.collapseOk, false); }); This code tests that semantic success alone is not enough when the collapse guard fails.

SQL migration code: CREATE TABLE proof_runs (id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, generated_at TEXT NOT NULL, claim_level TEXT NOT NULL, summary_json TEXT NOT NULL); CREATE INDEX proof_runs_claim_level_idx ON proof_runs (claim_level); This migration stores proof package runs, generated timestamps, claim levels, and serialized summaries for audit lookup.

Database persistence code: async function saveProofRun(db, run) { await db.prepare("INSERT INTO proof_runs (id, generated_at, claim_level, summary_json) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?)").bind(run.id, run.generatedAt, run.claimLevel, JSON.stringify(run.summary)).run(); } This function writes proof package metadata into the same audit table created by the migration.

Unit test code: test("ranked selector chooses strongest passing head", () => { const selected = selectRankedValidatedHead({ candidateHeadId: "governance", fallbackHeadId: "default", reportsByHead }); assert.equal(selected.selectedHeadId, "bookRoot"); assert.match(selected.reason, /best ranked accepted head/); }); This test verifies head selection, accepted ranking, and route override behavior.

Regression test code: test("ranked selector preserves inspection when all heads fail", () => { const selected = selectRankedValidatedHead({ candidateHeadId: "default", fallbackHeadId: "default", reportsByHead: failingReports }); assert.equal(selected.selectedHeadId, "default"); assert.match(selected.reason, /no ranked head passed/); }); This test preserves failure visibility instead of hiding bad semantic margins.
